units.source_text: 源氏心中思量：

en.t: Genji thought to himself:

units.source_text: 三公主所生的薰君要长一辈，不该和皇子们同列。

en.t: Kaoru, born to the Third Princess, belonged to an older generation and ought not to be ranked alongside the imperial princes.

units.source_text: 但恐三公主会疑心他有所偏爱，反而对她不起。

en.t: But he feared that the Third Princess might suspect him of favoritism, which would in turn be unfair to her.

units.source_text: 源氏向来思虑周全，因此一直把薰君同皇子们一样抚爱。

en.t: Genji was always thoughtful in every respect, and so he had continued to cherish Kaoru just as he did the imperial princes.

units.source_text: 夕雾还不曾清楚地看见过这个异母弟。

en.t: Yugiri had not yet had a clear look at this half brother of his.

units.source_text: 此时薰君从帘隙探出头来，夕雾向地上拾起一个枯了的花枝来向他招呼，他就走出来了。

en.t: Just then Kaoru peered out through a gap in the blinds; Yugiri picked up a withered flowering branch from the ground and beckoned to him with it, and Kaoru came out.

units.source_text: 他身上只穿一件紫红色便服，肤色白润，丰采焕发，比皇子们更为美丽动人。

en.t: He wore only a single purplish-red informal robe; his complexion was fair and lustrous, and his radiant bearing made him even more beautiful and captivating than the princes.

units.source_text: 肌肉丰腴，清秀可爱。

en.t: His body was plump and well formed, with a pure, delicate charm.

units.source_text: 也许是夕雾心有成见而特别注目之故吧，但觉他的眼神虽比柏木稍稍锐利而明敏些，但眼梢的秀美之气，非常肖似柏木。

en.t: Perhaps it was because Yugiri already had a suspicion in mind and looked at him with special attention, but he felt that although the boy's eyes were a little sharper and more intelligent than Kashiwagi's, the graceful beauty at their corners closely resembled him.

units.source_text: 尤其是那口角生花的笑容，竟全然一致，或许是他一见就想起柏木的原故吧。

en.t: Above all, the flowerlike smile at the corners of his mouth was exactly the same, perhaps because the very sight of him had immediately brought Kashiwagi to mind.

units.source_text: 他推想父亲一定也早看出，因此更想探探他的口气了。

en.t: He supposed that his father must have noticed it long ago as well, and this made him all the more eager to sound him out.

units.source_text: 皇子们虽然令人想起他们是皇帝的儿子，因而显得气品高贵，其实也不过和世间寻常美貌儿童相同而已。

en.t: The princes, because they reminded one that they were the emperor's sons, seemed noble in bearing, but in truth they were no more than ordinary handsome children of the world.

units.source_text: 可是这个薰君，实在非常优越，具有一种异样的美姿。

en.t: But this Kaoru was truly far superior, possessing a beauty of an unusual kind.

units.source_text: 夕雾把他们比较一下，想道：“啊呀，真可怜啊！

en.t: Yugiri compared them and thought, Ah, how pitiful!

units.source_text: 如果我所怀疑的真是事实，那么，柏木的父大臣如此悲伤，

en.t: If what I suspect is really true, then Kashiwagi's father, the Minister, is grieving so deeply,

units.source_text: 常常哭着叹惜没有人来报道柏木有子，盼能抚养他的一个遗孤才好，

en.t: often weeping and lamenting that no one has come to tell him Kashiwagi had a child, wishing only that he might raise one orphan left behind by him,

units.source_text: 而我现在找到了不去报告，将受神佛惩罚了！”

en.t: and if I have now found that child yet fail to report it, I will be punished by the gods and Buddhas!

units.source_text: 然而立刻打消这念头：“哎呀，哪里会有这种事情！”

en.t: Yet he immediately dismissed the thought: No, how could such a thing be possible!

units.source_text: 但他还是没有把握，百思不得其解。

en.t: Still, he could not be certain, and no matter how he turned it over in his mind, he could not understand it.

units.source_text: 薰君性情柔驯，对夕雾很亲昵，夕雾觉得实在可爱。

en.t: Kaoru was gentle and obedient by nature and very affectionate toward Yugiri, who found him truly endearing.
